changes.content_zh:
本次更新主要修复了上一版本中云端引导功能无法正常使用的问题，软件稳定性得到进一步提升。

需要特别说明的是，此为 V3 系列最终维护版本。至此，V3 版本的所有功能迭代将正式终止。自即日起，我们将停止对 V3 系列新增特性的开发工作，全力保障 V4 大版本的顺利交付与上线。
changes.content_en:
This update primarily addresses an issue from the previous version where the cloud-based bootstrapping feature could not be properly activated. With this fix, overall software stability has been further enhanced.

Please note that this release marks the final maintenance update for the V3 series. As of this version, all feature development for the V3 line will officially cease. Effective immediately, our team will discontinue the development of new features for V3 and will shift our full focus and resources toward ensuring the successful delivery and launch of the upcoming V4 major release.
